claims.quote: Gastrodermus gracilis, long known as Corydoras gracilis, is a small armoured catfish from the central Amazon basin in Brazil, known from the rio Juriti in Pará to the rio Juma in Amazonas.

Native to the central Amazon basin in Brazil, where its known range extends from the rio Juriti in Pará state to the rio Juma, a tributary of the rio Aripuanã within the rio Madeira watershed in Amazonas state.
